title: Network pharmacology and molecular docking reveal that honeysuckle blood components mitigate smoke inhalation-induced lung injury via NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Zou, Hai; Chang, Xiaoru; Wu, Yang; Mou, Xiaozhou; Fan, Haojun; Lv, Qi
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究金银花血中成分缓解烟雾吸入性肺损伤的NF-kappaB通路机制，虽涉及分子对接但对象为药物成分与蛋白靶点，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，方法简单且无AI/物理模拟深度，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The active components of honeysuckle alleviate smoke inhalation-induced lung injury by reducing inflammation and oxidative stress. This study aimed to investigate the intervention mechanism of honeysuckle blood components in smoke inhalation-induced lung injury using network pharmacology and molecular docking technology. The targets of honeysuckle blood-entering components were identified through the Swiss Target Prediction and Similarity Ensemble Approach databases. The target genes associated with smoke inhalation-induced lung injury were retrieved from the GeneCards and CTD databases. Cytoscape 3.7.1 software was employed to construct the blood component-target network of honeysuckle. GO biological process enrichment analysis of target genes related to inhalation-induced lung injury in Flos Lonicerae was performed using the DAVID tool. KEGG pathway enrichment analysis of anti-aspiration lung injury target genes in Flos Lonicera was conducted using the KOBAS 3.0 tool. The top six core targets with the highest PPIs in the network were selected for molecular docking verification. AutoDock was used to perform molecular docking with the blood-entering components of honeysuckle to verify their binding capabilities. A total of 95 targets of the blood components of honeysuckle and 960 targets related to smoke inhalation-induced lung injury were identified through network pharmacological analysis. Fifteen common targets of the blood components of honeysuckle were identified: CTSD, KLF5, TTR, HIF1A, CAPN1, GRIN1, ADAM10, ERAP1, NFE2L2, LGALS3, TLR4, GRB2, NF-kappaB1, RPS6KA1, and PTPN11. Network PPI analysis indicated that NF-kappaB1 was among the core targets. GO and KEGG enrichment analyses revealed that the components of Lonicerae lonicerae in the blood exerted therapeutic effects by regulating biological processes such as inflammation, apoptosis, oxidative stress, and the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Molecular docking results showed that the blood components of honeysuckle exhibited strong binding affinities to IL-1beta, NF-kappaB, and other core targets. This study revealed the potential mechanism of action of honeysuckle blood-entering components against smoke inhalation-induced lung injury through the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, NF-kappaB1, and other core targets, using network pharmacology and molecular docking techniques, thereby providing a theoretical foundation for further research on the application of honeysuckle in treating smoke inhalation-induced lung injury.
abstract_zh: 金银花活性成分通过减轻炎症和氧化应激缓解烟雾吸入性肺损伤。本研究旨在利用网络药理学和分子对接技术，探讨金银花血中成分对烟雾吸入性肺损伤的干预机制。通过Swiss Target Prediction和Similarity Ensemble Approach数据库鉴定金银花血中成分的靶点。从GeneCards和CTD数据库检索与烟雾吸入性肺损伤相关的靶基因。采用Cytoscape 3.7.1软件构建金银花血中成分-靶点网络。使用DAVID工具对金银花中与吸入性肺损伤相关的靶基因进行GO生物过程富集分析。使用KOBAS 3.0工具对金银花抗吸入性肺损伤靶基因进行KEGG通路富集分析。选取网络中PPI最高的前六个核心靶点进行分子对接验证。使用AutoDock与金银花血中成分进行分子对接，以验证其结合能力。通过网络药理学分析，共鉴定出金银花血中成分的95个靶点和960个与烟雾吸入性肺损伤相关的靶点。鉴定出金银花血中成分的15个共同靶点：CTSD、KLF5、TTR、HIF1A、CAPN1、GRIN1、ADAM10、ERAP1、NFE2L2、LGALS3、TLR4、GRB2、NF-kappaB1、RPS6KA1和PTPN11。网络PPI分析表明，NF-kappaB1是核心靶点之一。GO和KEGG富集分析显示，金银花血中成分通过调节炎症、凋亡、氧化应激及NF-kappaB信号通路等生物过程发挥治疗作用。分子对接结果表明，金银花血中成分与IL-1beta、NF-kappaB及其他核心靶点表现出较强的结合亲和力。本研究通过网络药理学和分子对接技术，揭示了金银花血中成分通过NF-kappaB信号通路、NF-kappaB1及其他核心靶点对抗烟雾吸入性肺损伤的潜在作用机制，从而为进一步研究金银花在治疗烟雾吸入性肺损伤中的应用提供了理论基础。
